title: Webel
summary: A services marketplace in production with thousands of users. I work as a Frontend Developer across the whole platform: the B2B product, the internal dashboard, the programmatic SEO platform and the core marketplace.
problem: Hiring professional services (home improvements, lessons, care, events) is still an opaque process: comparing options is hard, pricing is unclear and coordinating schedules means endless message threads.
audience: People who need to hire a service, professionals offering their work, and companies managing services for their teams.
role: Frontend Developer on the product team, working across the platform's four areas with React and TypeScript.
responsibilities: Development and evolution of the marketplace frontend: search, service pages, booking and tracking.
Building Webel Business, the B2B product, with its own flows and permissions.
Development of the internal dashboard the team uses to operate the platform.
Frontend implementation of the programmatic SEO platform: templates and pages generated at scale.
Maintaining the design system and the technical quality of the shared frontend.
decisions: Shared components across the four areas, so each new product costs less than the one before.
Performance and technical SEO treated as product requirements, not maintenance chores.
Clear separation between each vertical's logic (B2B, marketplace, SEO) and the common UI foundation.
outcomes: A live platform in production under continuous development for years.
Thousands of programmatic SEO pages capturing organic demand.
Four product fronts sustained by a common frontend foundation.
